titleEn: How Much Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Port Coquitlam, BC? Real 2026 Project Prices
titleZh: 满地宝浴室装修费用2026：真实工程价格解析
contentEn:
A bathroom renovation in Port Coquitlam, BC costs between $14,000 and $85,000 in 2026, depending on scope. A standard refresh starts around $14,000–$25,000, a mid-range renovation runs $25,000–$50,000, and a luxury custom bathroom lands at $50,000–$85,000 or higher. These figures are drawn from actual Reno Stars project costs in Port Coquitlam and across the Tri-Cities area.

Cost by Renovation Scope

Renovation TypeCost RangeWhat Is Included
Standard refresh$14,000 – $25,000New vanity, toilet, faucet, bath refinishing, paint, tile re-grout
Mid-range renovation$25,000 – $50,000New walk-in shower, vanity, toilet, flooring, lighting, custom tile
Luxury custom$50,000 – $85,000+Custom tile, heated floors, freestanding tub, premium fixtures, full layout change

What Drives Costs in Port Coquitlam

Port Coquitlam homes range from 1970s–1990s townhouses in Citadel Hills to newer single-family homes in Hyde Park. Older townhouses frequently need full plumbing rerouting when converting a tub to a walk-in shower, which adds $3,000–$8,000 to the project. Newer homes with modern plumbing allow for more straightforward installations at the lower end of the cost spectrum.

Material selection is the biggest variable. Porcelain tile runs $8–$25 per square foot installed. Natural stone (slate, marble) can reach $30–$80 per square foot. A curbless walk-in shower with glass enclosure adds $4,000–$12,000 depending on glass thickness and hardware. Heated floor systems run $1,500–$4,000 installed.

Planning a bathroom renovation in Port Coquitlam, Coquitlam, or Port Moody? Get a free quote from Reno Stars.

Real Tri-Cities Bathroom Project Examples

Reno Stars has completed bathroom renovations throughout the Tri-Cities. A standard bathroom renovation in Coquitlam included a walk-in shower conversion with custom tile work. A three-and-a-half bathroom renovation in Delta showcased premium fixtures across multiple baths. A master bathroom renovation in Vancouver featured custom features including heated flooring and a curbless shower. These examples show the range of scopes and budgets available to Port Coquitlam homeowners.

Timeline: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take?

  • Standard refresh: 1–2 weeks
  • Mid-range renovation: 3–5 weeks
  • Luxury custom: 5–8 weeks

Do You Need a Permit in Port Coquitlam?

Most bathroom renovations in Port Coquitlam do not require a building permit. Permits are needed only when work involves plumbing re-routing, structural changes, or electrical panel upgrades. Shower conversions and vanity replacements typically fall under cosmetic renovation and do not need a permit. Reno Stars confirms permit requirements during the quoting stage.

How much does a small bathroom renovation cost in Port Coquitlam?

A standard bathroom refresh in Port Coquitlam — including new vanity, toilet, faucet, bath refinishing, paint, and tile re-grout — typically costs $14,000–$25,000. Timeline is 1–2 weeks.

What is the average cost of a bathroom renovation in Port Coquitlam, BC?

The average mid-range bathroom renovation in Port Coquitlam costs $25,000–$50,000 in 2026. This covers a walk-in shower, new vanity and toilet, custom tile work, updated flooring, and new lighting in a standard-sized bathroom.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Port Coquitlam?

Most bathroom renovations in Port Coquitlam do not require a permit. Permits are only needed for plumbing re-routing, structural changes, or electrical panel upgrades. Standard vanity and toilet replacements, shower conversions, and cosmetic updates typically do not need a permit.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Port Coquitlam?

A standard bathroom refresh takes 1–2 weeks. A mid-range renovation takes 3–5 weeks. A luxury custom bathroom with layout changes takes 5–8 weeks.

Does Reno Stars do bathroom renovations in Port Coquitlam?

Yes. Reno Stars has completed bathroom renovations throughout the Tri-Cities area, including Port Coquitlam, Coquitlam, and Port Moody. Quotes are free and include a detailed scope, material options, and timeline.
contentZh:
满地宝（Port Coquitlam）浴室装修费用在2026年介于$14,000至$85,000之间，具体取决于装修范围。标准翻新起价约$14,000至$25,000，中档装修为$25,000至$50,000，豪华定制浴室则高达$50,000至$85,000或以上。这些数据基于聚星装修在满地宝及温哥华三联市（Tri-Cities）地区的实际项目费用。

按装修范围的费用明细

装修类型费用范围包含项目
标准翻新$14,000 – $25,000新洗手台、马桶、水龙头、浴缸翻新、油漆、瓷砖勾缝
中档装修$25,000 – $50,000步入式淋浴间、新洗手台、马桶、地板、照明、定制瓷砖
豪华定制$50,000 – $85,000+定制瓷砖、地暖、獨立式浴缸、高端五金、全布局改动

满地宝装修费用上涨的主要原因

满地宝的住宅类型多样，从Citadel Hills地区1970至1990年代的联排别墅到Hyde Park地区较新的独立屋不等。老旧联排别墅在将浴缸改造为步入式淋浴间时，通常需要全面管道改线，额外费用约$3,000至$8,000。新建住宅配备现代管道系统，装修费用可控制在较低范围内。

材料选择是最大的变量。陶瓷瓷砖每平方尺安装费用为$8至$25。天然石材（板岩、大理石）可达每平方尺$30至$80。步入式无障碍淋浴间配玻璃隔断根据玻璃厚度和五金配件不同，额外费用为$4,000至$12,000。地暖系统安装费用为$1,500至$4,000。

三联市真实浴室装修案例

聚星装修已在三联市完成多个浴室装修工程。高贵林一个标准浴室装修包含步入式淋浴间改造和定制瓷砖工程。Delta一个三间半浴室装修展示了多个浴室使用高端五金配件。温哥华一个主人浴室装修配备了地暖和無障碍淋浴间等定制设施。这些案例展示了满地宝业主可选择的工程范围和预算级别。

工期：浴室装修需要多长时间？

  • 标准翻新：1至2周
  • 中档装修：3至5周
  • 豪华定制：5至8周

满地宝需要许可证吗？

满地宝大多数浴室装修不需要建筑许可证。只有在涉及管道改线、结构改动或电气面板升级时才需要许可证。淋浴间改造和洗手台更换通常属于 Cosmetic 装修范围，不需要许可证。Reno Stars会在报价阶段确认许可证要求。

满地宝小浴室装修费用是多少？

满地宝标准浴室翻新（包括新洗手台、马桶、水龙头、浴缸翻新、油漆和瓷砖勾缝）通常费用为$14,000至$25,000。工期为1至2周。

满地宝浴室装修平均费用是多少？

2026年满地宝中档浴室装修平均费用为$25,000至$50,000，包含步入式淋浴间、新洗手台和马桶、定制瓷砖、新地板和新照明。

满地宝浴室装修需要许可证吗？

满地宝大多数浴室装修不需要许可证。只有在涉及管道改线、结构改动或电气面板升级时才需要许可证。标准和洗手台更换、淋浴间改造和 Cosmetic 翻新通常不需要许可证。

满地宝浴室装修需要多长时间？

满地宝标准浴室翻新需1至2周。中档装修需3至5周。带布局改动的豪华定制浴室需5至8周。

Reno Stars是否承接满地宝的浴室装修？

是的。聚星装修已在三联市地区（包括满地宝、高贵林和满地宝）完成多个浴室装修工程。报价免费，包含详细工程范围、材料选择和工期安排。
